origin.title: MotoGP 06
origin.calibration: Absolute RPM mapped to printed source ticks; 0..6000 uses the bottom zero and 6000 marks. 19000 uses the remaining face arc beyond 18000, keeping the needle clear of the speed box. Deliberately differs from the donor fixed native rotation formula.

restoration.method: Reviewed generated artwork; original logical geometry and translucent background field retained.
restoration.note: A visual restoration, not a pixel-exact reproduction of original sprite pixels.
